findings.reason: sha1 builds a 12-hex-char de-duplication signature over finding ids, not a security control; the value is compared only with signatures this script wrote earlier.

sha1 builds a 6-hex-char cursor file-name disambiguator, not a security control; switching the digest renames every existing per-clone cursor and replays unread messages. Change only with a cursor migration.
